$comment: Advisories with no fix available from this repository. The audit gate runs at --level=high (.github/workflows/bun.yml), so anything new at high or critical fails the build. Every entry needs a reason and an id.

allow.reason: No fixed release exists: 3.0.3 is the newest version published, and bun does not support range-keyed overrides, so the vulnerable 3.x line cannot be swapped without forcing an incompatible major onto the micromatch/fast-glob chain.
